name: EuroTeleSites AG
summary: EuroTeleSites AG provides telecommunications infrastructure and solutions under the EuroTeleSites brand in Austria, Bulgaria, Croatia, Slovenia, North Macedonia, Serbia, and Slovenia. The company offers various solutions for building and maintaining various telecommunications services. It also provides space for installation of the required active components of the mobile network operator (MNO), including antennas, directional radio antennas, and air conditioning and access systems; contract management services comprising colocation management for existing and future contracts; and structure, air-conditioning, security, and energy systems maintenance services.
